subject.title: fix(gateway): classify chat error kind via canonical failover reasons

question: Should the shipped `openclaw/plugin-sdk/infra-runtime` exports `ErrorKind` and `detectErrorKind` remain through the current major version, or may this PR intentionally remove them?
rationale: The symbols are proven shipped plugin API, and the compatibility barrel explicitly exists to keep old plugins working; only maintainers can authorize a versioned breaking removal.

options.title: Preserve current-major compatibility
options.body: Keep the deprecated exports while removing all gateway runtime dependence on the duplicate classifier.

options.title: Approve a versioned removal
options.body: Remove the names only as an explicitly documented plugin API break with upgrade guidance.

recommendation.title: Preserve current-major compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the deprecated exports while removing all gateway runtime dependence on the duplicate classifier.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the original classifier and the compatibility barrel that exposes it.
